description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class `DestroyReportToPurgeStrategyTest` for testing the `DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy` in the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It sets up test data, executes the purge method, and verifies that records with subordinate or supervisor ID 1 are removed.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy's purge functionality within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the purge strategy with specific parameters, and loads test data fixtures.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Executes the purge method and asserts that relevant ReportTo records have been deleted.
